text:
Ben K.: quick postmortem follow-up — recurring midnight DB connection surges. need concise runbook edits, owners for each action, and short due dates so PM can close the loop. who can pick what?

Luisa M.: i can own the runbook section: step-by-step triage + copy/paste commands. i'll keep it to one page with a TL;DR for oncall. target PR in 4 business days.

Derek Y.: i'll take the automation hooks: health-check endpoint + a tiny CI smoke that runs nightly. will add a one-liner curl health check and a PromQL snippet. due 2024-07-03.

Olga V.: i'll handle escalation mapping and pager text templates. propose thresholds: conn_util >75% for 8m -> L2 page, >92% for 2m -> L1 page + ops lead. will include weekend phone fallback. due 2024-06-28.

Ben K.: please also capture the recurring cause (bulk job overlap) as a separate action with an owner.

Luisa M.: triage snippet i'll add to the runbook:
```
# quick postgres active connections
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# tail API pods for connection errors
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | grep -i connection
# show worker backlog
kubectl -n prod get jobs -l job=nightly -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, active:.status.active, failed:.status.failed}'
# safe restart for worker pool
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=90s
```

Derek Y.: automation plan: expose conn_util metric, alert if >80% for 5m, and a curl check for oncall: `curl -fsS https://infra-health/redwood/conn` -> returns `{status:ok, conn_util: 0.62}`. will wire alert->runbook mapping.

Olga V.: escalation text examples i'll add: "DB connection utilization at {{conn_util}} >= 90% for 2m. If spike persists after mitigation steps, escalate to infra on-call and page ops-lead."

sre-bot: Created followups: FF-2101 (runbook triage) assigned Luisa M. due 2024-06-24, FF-2102 (health-check + alerts) assigned Derek Y. due 2024-07-03, FF-2103 (escalation map) assigned Olga V. due 2024-06-28, FF-2104 (job-stagger design) unassigned. Link: https://tracker.redwood/FF-2101

Ben K.: Luisa/Derek/Olga, confirm dates in tracker by EOD. i'll schedule 15m weekly check-ins until green. also please add a one-sentence test plan in each PR so QA can validate runbook steps.

Luisa M.: confirmed. PR will include test steps and a short rollback section.

Derek Y.: confirmed. i'll include Prometheus rule + CI smoke test and a link to alert.

Olga V.: confirmed. i'll add pager templates and weekend fallback numbers.

Ben K.: good. one more: Luisa, add a short section "fast mitigations" at top of runbook (disable nightly job window, throttle job submissions, restart worker) so oncall has immediate actions.

Luisa M.: will do. thanks.

Ben K.: closing note: tag FF-2101/2102/2103 in PRs and link the postmortem. :thumbsup:
